title: Bessie Smith compared with Ma Rainey
summary: He heard Bessie Smith in person and compares her singing to Ma Rainey's heavier voice and stage actions.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Well what about Bessie Smith and Mamie Smith and Trixie Smith and all those women, they all had Smith names, you know?

Well Bessie Smith, Bessie, I know her and she was a blues singer too. But all them other Smiths I don't know nothing about them. I have heard several of them but I don't know too much about them, you know?
But Bessie you heard definitely, ma'am.
I heard Bessie in person, yeah. I heard Bessie Smith in person. And all these others I haven't been around to them, you know what I mean?
Well how did Bessie compare with Ma Rainey? Would she sing like her or different or?

Well she sang, Ma Rainey's voice was more heavy than Bessie's voice. See, Bessie was a good singer but Ma Rainey had a heavier voice. And which to my knowledge I believe Bessie Smith beat her singing. I think she beat her singing. But Ma Rainey, her voice was so loud and her actions was more, you know what I mean? See, she had more actions.
Well what did she do? Did she kind of? Dance. She danced, don't you?
Oh yeah, she danced. She danced and make actions with all her songs, you know? And I can't think of none of them, so.
